title: Detection Model Provenance Record
description: Anchored once per retraining cycle. Establishes the 'immutable birth certificate' required by Objective 2: an auditor who holds an alert's model.model_digest can look up exactly which artifact produced it and when that artifact entered service. The deployed detector is the Phase 1 LightGBM multiclass model over 25 NetFlow features and seven coarse threat categories, trained on NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018-v2.

model_id.description: Stable logical identifier for the deployed model. Carries Phase 1's own model_card.json:model_id_sha256, so an alert traces back to the producer's identifier and not merely to a label chosen by the logging layer.

model_digest.description: SHA-256 digest computed over the serialised model plus every other prediction-affecting component: feature_order, label_order, hyperparameters, thresholds. Recomputing this digest from the listed components and the artifact bytes must reproduce this exact value; see src/model_provenance.py:compute_model_digest.

artifact_content_address.description: Content address (e.g. sha256:<digest> local content-addressed store key, or an IPFS CID) of the full serialised model artifact, per the hybrid on-chain/off-chain storage architecture of Objective 2. Only this address and model_digest are anchored on-chain; the multi-megabyte artifact itself is never committed.

feature_order.description: Ordered feature names as consumed by the model. Part of the digest because reordering features silently changes predictions without changing the model file.

hyperparameters.description: Frozen hyperparameters of the deployed configuration.

thresholds.description: Per-class decision thresholds in effect for this artifact, if applicable. Empty object permitted for a model family that has not yet adopted per-class thresholds.

anchored_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which this provenance record was anchored on-chain.
